queries.parcels: MATCH (p:Parcel) RETURN p.parcel_id AS pid, p.band AS band
queries.roads: MATCH (r:RoadSegment)-[e]->(p:Parcel) RETURN p.parcel_id AS pid, r.road_id AS rid, r.passable AS ok
queries.homes: MATCH (h:HomeGroup)-[e]->(p:Parcel) RETURN p.parcel_id AS pid, h.houses AS houses, h.has_critical_facility AS crit
queries.water: MATCH (w:WaterSource)-[e1]->(r:RoadSegment)-[e2]->(p:Parcel) RETURN p.parcel_id AS pid, r.road_id AS rid, r.passable AS ok, w.water_id AS wid
queries.crew: MATCH (c:CrewAccess)-[e]->(p:Parcel) RETURN p.parcel_id AS pid, c.crew_type AS ct, c.reachable AS reach

note: GQL returns traversed rows; set logic done client-side.
